content_zh:
第971章 晋升、支柱·领袖，神庙与斩痕-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第971章 晋升、支柱·领袖，神庙与斩痕-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
新世界就像一个恒星，各个文明宇宙就是被它捕获的行星，它们一起形成了一个统一的宇宙群落。
但于渊却隐隐明白，就是这无尽的虚空深处，或许就有其他的宇宙群落。
不断有文明宇宙被宇宙群落规则捕获，改造吸收，成为宇宙群落的一部分。
有些文明宇宙则运气相当不好，与新世界直接碰撞，文明破灭，这留下一座座遗迹。
同样也看到文明宇宙与新世界连接后，被改造，游戏化后并入新世界规则。
首先就是特殊进化序列【序列——文明·支柱】散发微光，面板最后化作与三支柱一模一样的形态。
content_en:
Chapter 971 Promotion, Pillar Leader, Temple and Cut Mark - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewer"
Chapter 971 Promotion, Pillar Leader, Temple and Cut Mark - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewer"
The new world is like a star, and each civilized universe is the planet captured by it. Together, they form a unified universe community.
But Yu Yuan vaguely understood that there might be other cosmic communities in the depths of this endless void.
Civilized universes are constantly being captured, transformed and absorbed by the rules of the universe community, and become part of the universe community.
Some civilized universes are very unlucky. They directly collide with the new world and the civilization is destroyed, leaving ruins behind.
We also see that after the civilized universe is connected to the new world, it is transformed, gamified and incorporated into the new world rules.
First, the special evolutionary sequence [Sequence-Civilization·Pillar] emits a faint light, and the panel finally turns into the same form as the three pillars.
